_comment: G2 real-world source selection (Phase 5). Chosen 2026-10-07 from Wikimedia Commons searches restricted to files whose structured data declares CC0 (P275=Q6938433) or public-domain status (P6216=Q19652), from 300-900 px previews only (no full-size file was decoded and no edit was run before the protocol was committed). Criteria: a real camera photograph; licence CC0 or public domain; within photo-gen's input limits (no resizing); no public figures, no minors as subjects, no edit that alters a person's identity; subject categories of directive section 11; a mix of orientations. fetch_sources.py re-checks the licence from the Commons API at download time and records full provenance in source-manifest.json.
